system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Namaste, can you help me? Resolves ambiguous eligibility results when pmkisan_check_eligibility returns conflicting or unclear status. Here are my details: my aadhaar_number is 100020006844.

function.name: pmkisan_resolve_eligibility_ambiguity
function.description: Resolves ambiguous eligibility results when pmkisan_check_eligibility returns conflicting or unclear status. Provides detailed breakdown of eligibility criteria and which specific conditions are met or unmet. Requires a valid session_token. This tool does NOT change eligibility status — it only provides detailed analysis. Fails if no eligibility check has been performed yet or the farmer is not registered.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.
